findings.detail: The pinned libzvbi source explicitly licenses src/packet-830.c and src/pdc.c under GPL version 2 only. They are included in libzvbi_la_SOURCES. src/packet.c calls the packet-830 decoder functions without a compile-time exclusion; FFmpeg enables its libzvbi decoder and the final executable link includes -lzvbi. This cannot be cleared as an LGPLv3-only dependency chain from the supplied evidence.
findings.linkageAssessment: Source/build/link-command inference; not a recovered object-level link map. The absence of stripped symbol names in the EXE is not proof of exclusion.
findings.resolution: For a future redistribution candidate, rebuild the same FFmpeg core with libzvbi disabled, or obtain authoritative upstream licence clarification/exclusion evidence. Do not rewrite upstream notices or change the accepted installation.

otherChecks.result: No plugin entry-point references found outside the plugin source/tests in the scanned dependency trees; FFmpeg source has no such references. Static plugin archives occur on the link line without whole-archive. Their mere presence on that line does not establish GPL code incorporation. The supplied future-build patch disables these unused plugins explicitly.
Original project PolyForm terms remain separate. Existing NOTICE explicitly preserves third-party terms; the app invokes a separate FFmpeg executable. No project relicensing performed.
Explicit FreeType acknowledgement, source-header copyright blocks and declaration-only Cargo notices added. Original source/notice bytes retained.

Exact sources, vendor patches/recipes and reconstructed rav1e resolution retained privately. A future binary distribution must deliver required source/build materials to recipients; no public publication authorised.
GCC runtime exception and underlying GPLv3 text included. Toolchain provenance records GCC 16.2.0; no assertion that the application itself becomes GPL because it uses the eligible GCC runtime.
Official Node 24.15.0 executable/licence pins and MIT npm notices verified previously; native helper source/body correspondence retained. No newly identified redistribution mismatch.

Reviewed GPL-header hits separately from linked-library terms: GLib valgrind.h has its own BSD permission; MinGW stdarg.h has an inclusion exception; SDL HIDAPI permits a BSD alternative (selected); glslang generated parser carries the Bison exception. GME uses default LGPL Nuked rather than GPL MAME. Fribidi command-line getopt, GMP demos, XZ scan tool, xxHash CLI, libtheora experimental transcoder, SOXR tests, libffi tests and libiconv/gnulib build tooling are not selected runtime library code. PCRE2 JIT, FreeType debug dlg and libjxl test/tool submodules are disabled; their absence is not a missing linked source.
